messages:
sam_finance: FYI invoice INV-2098 ($3,200) just failed on card charge. Stripe webhook: `status=requires_payment_method` -> `error=authentication_required`. Card issuer declined for SCA. Need a plan to recover payment without hurting CS relationship.

leo_support: Do we have the raw decline code? Can we surface the stripe link to the customer to retry with SCA?

sam_finance: Stripe event shows: ```type=payment_intent.payment_failed; code=authentication_required; decline_code=do_not_honor; message='The card was declined.'```

csm_anika: Reached out to the customer (Finance AP). They can re-run the card if we send a secure retry link. Prefer not to ask for ACH right now.

stripe-bot: PaymentIntent pi_3Jk2... requires_action -> next_action: use_stripe_sdk (3DS2). Hosted retry link: https://checkout.stripe.com/retry/pi_3Jk2... (expires in 24h).

sam_finance: Ok — plan: 1) Email hosted retry link to AP contact with steps for 3DS prompt, 2) schedule 1 automated retry in 6 hours, 3) if still failing after 24h, offer ACH/Wire as fallback and pause dunning for 48h while CSM intervenes. Approving that? @cfo_emma

cfo_emma: Agree with conservative approach. Make sure we capture consent if we move to ACH. Also flag revenue recognition: if payment not captured within 7 days, move to deferred revenue review.

leo_support: Drafting email now: "Hi — your card attempt for INV-2098 failed due to bank authentication. Please click this secure link to authenticate the payment (3DS) within 24 hours: <stripe retry link>. If you prefer to pay via ACH/wire, reply and we'll provide wire instructions. — Sam, Billing"

csm_anika: I'll follow up via phone if no response in 3 hours. Customer is small ops team, good to call.

sam_finance: Payments-bot, schedule the retry and log the event.

payments-bot: Scheduled one automated retry for payment_intent pi_3Jk2... at 6 hours from now (timestamp 1901241490). Payment record updated: /payments/INV-2098. Dunning paused for 48h. Tagging @sam_finance.

stripe-bot: If retry fails, recommended next steps: (a) create PaymentMethod via card collection and confirm PaymentIntent with return_url, (b) fallback to ACH (manual) with KYC for transfers > $5k.

leo_support: Noted. Also adding a small UX change request: surface 'authentication_required' in billing UI with a one-click "Resend retry link". Filing BL-4892.

sam_finance: Filed BL-4892. Thanks everyone — tracking here until captured.
